description: Gloam play-by-post chat: an underspecified brief whose real rules, vocabulary and voice live in the owner answers.

outcomes.description: Brief-level checks any implementation of the brief should pass
Owner voice: banned phrases, exclamation marks and emoji absent
Whispers only Keeper to player; never leak
X-card anonymous, pauses in-character posting, Keeper resumes, veils the pointed post
In character speaks as the own character; Keeper must name each in-character post
Edits only by the author and only until someone else posts after
Only the Keeper releases a player; access ends, posts stay
A failed post keeps the text, says so and resends exactly once
Damaged data refuses start; unwritable storage refuses the post and keeps earlier posts
Simultaneous posts all land in arrival order
Only the Keeper draws a scene to a close; then read-only
